summary: As of mid-2026, the large language model landscape is dominated by a handful of frontier models with ChatGPT/GPT-5 maintaining the largest consumer mindshare at ~54-56% of AI chatbot web visits, while Gemini has surged dramatically with ~450% year-over-year growth to claim roughly 26-28% of web traffic. Enterprise API adoption tells a different story, with Anthropic's Claude leading enterprise API usage at 40% share, and open-weight models like Meta Llama 4 and DeepSeek V4 achieving near-parity with closed models on key benchmarks while being available across all major cloud aggregators.

models.name: GPT-5
models.popularity_notes: ChatGPT holds 53.9% of worldwide AI chatbot web visits in May 2026 and OpenAI leads LLM API market share; GPT-5 is available on Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, and Snowflake Cortex, massively amplifying enterprise reach beyond direct API numbers.
strengths: Largest developer ecosystem and tooling support
Best-in-class multi-step reasoning and conversational ability
Widest aggregator coverage (Azure, AWS, Snowflake, Vertex)
Strong real-time interaction capabilities
Extensive plugin and API integrations
models.best_for: General-purpose enterprise applications, conversational AI, multi-step reasoning workflows, and teams needing the broadest ecosystem support

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.popularity_notes: Gemini reached 2.9 billion monthly web visits in May 2026 (up ~450% year-over-year) and holds ~27.9% of AI chatbot web traffic globally; natively available on Google Vertex AI and deeply integrated into Google Cloud enterprise services used by millions of organizations.
strengths: Industry-leading 1M token context window
Deep Google Workspace and Cloud integration
Strong multimodal capabilities
Rapid year-over-year adoption growth
Native Vertex AI availability for enterprise
models.best_for: Long-document processing, multimodal tasks, Google Cloud-native enterprise deployments, and organizations already invested in Google ecosystem

models.name: Claude Opus 5 / Claude Fable 5.1
models.popularity_notes: Anthropic leads enterprise API usage at 40% share (Menlo Ventures 2025), and Claude reached 952.6 million monthly web visits in May 2026 (up ~855% year-over-year); available on AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and Azure, making it the top enterprise API model by aggregator-weighted adoption.
strengths: Leads enterprise API adoption at 40% share
Top-ranked on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
Best-in-class safety and alignment for regulated industries
Exceptional long-context reasoning and document analysis
Available across all three major cloud aggregators
models.best_for: Enterprise-grade applications requiring safety, compliance, long-context document analysis, and complex reasoning tasks in regulated industries

models.name: Meta Llama 4
models.popularity_notes: Llama models consistently top HuggingFace download charts with billions of cumulative downloads, and Llama 4 is available on AWS Bedrock, Azure AI, Google Vertex AI, IBM watsonx, and Snowflake Cortex, giving it unmatched aggregator breadth among open-weight models.
strengths: Highest HuggingFace download volume among open models
Available across every major cloud aggregator
No licensing cost for self-hosted deployment
Strong general reasoning capabilities
Massive open-source community and fine-tuning ecosystem
models.best_for: Teams needing self-hosted or on-premise deployment, cost-sensitive enterprise workloads, and organizations wanting full model control without vendor lock-in

models.name: DeepSeek V4 / DeepSeek-V3
models.popularity_notes: DeepSeek holds 4.1% of global AI chatbot web visits and its V4-Pro (1.6T parameter MoE, released April 2026) matches Claude Opus 4.x on SWE-Bench Verified; available on AWS Bedrock and Azure AI, and leads open-source LLM adoption for coding tasks on OpenRouter.
strengths: State-of-the-art coding and reasoning at low cost
1.6T parameter MoE architecture with efficient inference
1M token context window
Near-parity with frontier closed models on SWE-Bench
Developed with significantly lower compute investment than peers
models.best_for: Coding assistance, software engineering automation, cost-sensitive API workloads, and teams wanting frontier-level open-weight models for self-hosting

models.name: Grok-3
models.popularity_notes: Grok holds 2.4% of worldwide AI chatbot web visits in May 2026 and benefits from deep integration with X (Twitter) platform giving it unique real-time data access; listed among top-5 LLMs in mid-2026 by multiple analyst sources.
strengths: Real-time information access via X platform integration
Strong reasoning and STEM performance
Witty and less filtered conversational style
Rapid capability improvements across model generations
Available via xAI API for developers
models.best_for: Real-time information retrieval, social media analytics, STEM reasoning tasks, and users wanting up-to-the-minute data in responses

models.name: Qwen3 / Qwen 2.5
models.popularity_notes: The Qwen family has been adopted by over 90,000 enterprises and Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking has redefined the open-weights landscape; available on AWS Bedrock and Alibaba Cloud with strong multilingual capabilities driving adoption across Asia-Pacific enterprise markets.
strengths: Over 90,000 enterprise adoptions globally
Leading multilingual and cross-lingual performance
Strong coding benchmarks with 235B parameter variant
Available as open-weight for self-hosted deployment
Cost-efficient at scale via Alibaba Cloud
models.best_for: Multilingual enterprise applications, Asia-Pacific market deployments, self-hosted open-weight workloads, and cost-efficient coding tasks

models.name: Mistral Large
models.popularity_notes: Mistral models rank among the most downloaded on HuggingFace and Mistral Large is available on AWS Bedrock, Azure AI, Google Vertex AI, and IBM watsonx, giving it broad aggregator reach; noted by analysts as a top pick for speed and efficiency among open-weight alternatives.
strengths: Excellent inference speed and efficiency
Available across AWS, Azure, Vertex AI, and IBM watsonx
Strong European data sovereignty compliance (GDPR-friendly)
High HuggingFace download volume
Competitive performance-to-cost ratio
models.best_for: Latency-sensitive applications, European enterprise deployments requiring data sovereignty, and teams needing a fast, efficient open-weight model with broad aggregator support

models.name: Perplexity Sonar
models.popularity_notes: Perplexity holds 1.3% of global AI chatbot web visits as of May 2026 and its Sonar API has seen rapid developer adoption for search-augmented generation use cases; Perplexity's API is used on OpenRouter and by developers building retrieval-augmented applications.
strengths: Built-in real-time web search and retrieval augmentation
Cited sources in every response for verifiability
Low and simple pricing model
Fast response times for search-grounded queries
Growing developer API adoption via OpenRouter
models.best_for: Search-augmented generation, research assistants, fact-checking workflows, and applications requiring real-time grounded responses with citations

models.name: Microsoft Phi-4
models.popularity_notes: Phi-4 holds 1.3% of global AI chatbot web visits and is natively available on Azure AI and integrated into Microsoft Copilot ecosystem used by over 1 billion Windows users; noted by analysts as top pick for high-performance reasoning in small-scale and edge deployments.
strengths: Exceptional reasoning performance relative to model size
Very low inference cost and compute requirements
Native Azure AI and Copilot integration
Suitable for edge and on-device deployment
Open-weight availability on HuggingFace
models.best_for: Edge deployment, cost-constrained enterprise workloads, on-device AI applications, and teams needing strong reasoning in a small model footprint
